Marano Jr., MD and Cornea & Refractive Subspecialist Dr. Sherief Raouf, MD.

## Laser Cataract Technology & Recovery Protocol
- **Femtosecond Laser Platform:** LENSAR® ALLY® Adaptive Cataract Treatment System with Augmented Reality™ 3D corneal biometry, cyclotorsion iris registration, and up to 50% lower ultrasound energy.
- **Anesthesia:** 100% topical numbing eye drops with light twilight relaxation — zero needles, zero retrobulbar injections, zero stitches, zero general anesthesia.
- **Procedure Time & Recovery:** ~10-minute single-suite outpatient microsurgery; most patients resume light daily routines and driving within 24–48 hours.

## FDA-Approved Premium Intraocular Lens (IOL) Guides
- [Clareon® Vivity® IOL Guide](https://premium-iol.maranoeye.com/clareon-vivity): Alcon non-diffractive Extended Depth of Focus (EDOF) lens utilizing X-WAVE™ wavefront-shaping technology. Delivers crisp 20/20 distance and continuous intermediate computer/dashboard focus with a night halo/glare profile statistically comparable to a standard monofocal lens (FDA PMA P930014/S126 & P190018).
- [Clareon® PanOptix® Pro Trifocal IOL Guide](https://premium-iol.maranoeye.com/panoptix-pro): Alcon next-generation trifocal IOL utilizing ENLIGHTEN® NXT optical technology (94% light utilization; 50% less light scatter than original 88% PanOptix). Engineered for near (40 cm), intermediate (60 cm), and distance independence; 99.2% of FDA trial patients would choose the same lens again (PMA P040020/S087; Zhu et al. 2023 meta-analysis PMID 36745314).
- [TECNIS PureSee™ Refractive EDOF IOL Guide](https://premium-iol.maranoeye.com/tecnis-puresee): Johnson & Johnson MedTech purely refractive EDOF lens built on high-Abbe-55 hydrophobic acrylic. Zero diffractive rings and the first FDA-approved EDOF IOL with zero clinical contrast sensitivity loss warning (FDA PMA P980040/S176).
- [How Cataracts Form & Lens Permanence Guide](https://premium-iol.maranoeye.com/cataract-education): Clinical guide to crystallin protein breakdown, the 5 stages of nuclear sclerosis, and why medical-grade acrylic IOLs never cloud, yellow, or develop cataracts again.

## Astigmatism, Medicare & Transparent Pricing Policy
- **$0 Toric Astigmatism Upgrade:** Custom Toric astigmatism correction is included at **no additional upgrade fee** on all premium lenses (Clareon Vivity, PanOptix Pro, and TECNIS PureSee) at Marano Eye Care.
- **Medicare & Commercial Insurance:** Core cataract surgery (CPT 66984), anesthesia, and facility fees are covered by Medicare Part B and major medical insurance plans (subject to standard deductible/copay).
- **Financing & Pre-Tax Savings:** Written benefit verification provided before scheduling; 100% HSA/FSA eligible plus 24-month 0% APR financing (~$170/mo for premium IOL packages) via CareCredit®.
